senses.gloss:
उल उल, अस्, m., Ved. a kind of wild animal;
N. of a man.

उलप उलप, अस्, m., Ved. a shrub, bush;
a wick; the stalk of a shrub used as a wick (?); a
creeping plant, a spreading creeper; the grass or reed
Saccharum Cylindricum; N. of a pupil of Kalāpin.

उल्लाप उल्-लाप, अस्, m. (fr. rt. लप् with उद्),
calling out in a loud voice; change of voice in grief,
sickness, &c.

उलप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. connected with or refer-
ring to a shrub &c.
उल्-लाप्य, अम्, n. a kind of drama.

उल्लकसन उल्लकसन, अम्, n. horripilation,
erection of the hairs of the body.

उल्लग्न उल्लग्न, अस्, m. the lagna (q. v.) of
any particular place.

उल्लङ्घ् उल्-लङ्घ् (उद्-ल्˚), cl. 1. P. A. -लङ्-
घति, -ते, -घितुम्, to leap over, pass over or beyond,
to cross over; transgress, exceed, violate, spurn.

उल्-लङ्घन, अम्, n. leaping or passing over or
beyond; transgression, exceeding.
उल्-लङ्घनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be transgressed.

उल्-लङ्घित, अस्, आ, अम्, jumped over or across,
passed over or beyond; exceeded, transgressed, vio-
lated, apostatized.
—उल्लङ्घित-शासन, अस्, आ, अम्,
transgressing orders, rebellious, disobedient.
—उल्लङ्-
घिताध्वन् (˚त-अध्˚), आ, आ, अ, having passed over
the road.

उल्-लङ्घ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be passed over or be-
yond, to be crossed; to be disregarded or neglected.

उल्लभ् उल्-लभ् (उद्-लभ्), cl. 1. A. -लभते,
-लब्धुम्, to obtain.

उल्लम्बित उल्-लम्बित (उद्-ल्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
erected, elevated.

उल्लल उल्-लल, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. लल्), covered
with thick hair; shaking, trembling.

उल्-लाल, N. of a metre of two verses, each con-
taining 15 + 13 syllabic instants.

उल्-ललत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, shaking, trembling; moving
irregularly or convulsively.
उल्-ललित, अस्, आ, अम्, shaken, trembling, agitated.

उल्लस् उल्-लस् (उद्-लस्), cl. 1. P. -लसति, -सि-
तुम्, to jump up, sport, play, dance, flash, shine:
Caus. P. -लासयति, -यितुम्, to cause to jump up or
play; to cause to shine; to divert, delight.

उल्-लस, अस्, आ, अम्, sporting, bright, shining;
merry, happy; going out, issuing.
—उल्लस-ता, f.
splendor, brilliancy; mirth, happiness, going forth,
issuing.

उल्-लास, अस्, m. jumping or leaping up, happiness,
joy; light, splendor; (in rhetoric) giving prominence
to any subject by comparison or opposition; division
of a book, chapter, section (e. g. आचारोल्लास, a chapter
treating of customs and observances).
उल्लास; add — increase, growth.

उल्-लसत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, sporting, dancing, brilliant,
shining; wantoning.

उल्-लसित, अस्, आ, अम्, shining, bright, splendid;
happy; ejected, brought to the top or surface, drawn
up, uplifted, brandishing.
—उल्लसित-हरिण-केतन,
अस्, आ, अम्, having its deer-marked banner gleaming
or fluttering.

उल्-लासित, अस्, आ, अम्, delighted, overjoyed, re-
joicing.

उल्-लासन, अस्, आ, अम्, causing to leap or dance;
(अम्), n. splendor.

उल्लाघ उल्लाघ, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be fr. rt.
लाघ्; in some of its senses perhaps related to
लघु), recovered from sickness, convalescent; dex-
trous, clever, intelligent; pure; happy, delighted;
wicked; black.
उल्लापिक, अस्, आ, अम्, betraying, indicating.
उल्-लापिन्, ई, इनी, इ, calling out.
